items.name: Say what changed
items.description: A short account of a change for someone who was not there.

items.name: Check before you say done
items.description: Run it, read it, and name what is not finished before reporting done.

items.name: List the open questions
items.description: Everything someone else has to decide, as a list you can tick.

items.name: Write a hand-over note
items.description: What whoever continues the work needs to know, and nothing else.

items.name: Check for drift
items.description: For a schedule: run the read-only plan against every stack the repository defines and list what differs from the code, or "nothing drifted". It never applies. It needs the repository's own tool and cloud access that can read: give the agent a read-only profile, since it runs with your cloud access.

items.name: Describe this stack
items.description: Read the infrastructure code in a folder and write down what it creates, its environments, what costs money (no prices), where its state lives, and what to know before changing it. It needs the code only, no cloud access.

items.name: Reproduce, fix, verify
items.description: For a bug: see it fail first, find the cause, stop for your yes, fix it, show that it is fixed.

items.name: Read a change and report
items.description: For reviewing someone else's work: read it, check it, write down what you found.

items.name: Plan, review, apply
items.description: For infrastructure as code: say the change, plan it with the repository's own tool, stop for your yes, apply that plan, check. The approval is a checkpoint for you, not a lock: the agent runs with your cloud access. Give it a read-only profile for planning.
